questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Sets, Relations & Functions :: Advanced Mathematical Structure (Type 1)
questions.question: If a function $f: \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\} \to \mathbb{R}$ in [Sets, Relations & Functions] satisfies the functional equation $f(x) + 2 f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) = 3x$, what is the value of $f(2)$?
questions.solution: At $x = 2$: $f(2) + 2f(1/2) = 6$. At $x = 1/2$: $f(1/2) + 2f(2) = 3/2 \implies 2f(1/2) + 4f(2) = 3$. Subtracting the first equation: $3f(2) = 3 - 6 = -3 \implies f(2) = -1$.
questions.explanation: Solve using rigorous mathematical proofs and transformations in Sets, Relations & Functions.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Sets, Relations & Functions :: Quantitative Deduction
questions.question:
Evaluate the integer value of the limit in [Sets, Relations & Functions]:
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} \times 6$$
questions.solution: Using Taylor series $\sin x = x - \frac{x^3}{6} + O(x^5)$, we have $\frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} = \frac{1}{6} + O(x^2) \to \frac{1}{6}$. Multiplied by $6$, the value is $1$.
questions.explanation: Derive using rigorous mathematical theorems in Sets, Relations & Functions.
